successors.name: Naqada culture
successors.text: Lower Egypt and the Faiyum: Maadi, Buto, Tell Ibrahim Awad, Tell el-Rub'a, Tell el-Farkha; the culture "emerged from the earliest Neolithic sites of the Nile Valley, in the Faiyum region"

ledger.x: 3800 BCE: the Maadian culture of Lower Egypt, trading partner of Chalcolithic Palestine.
3200 BCE: Upper Egypt absorbs the Delta.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: the Delta and the Faiyum as regions; the southern limit against the Naqada culture is soft.
